title: Find the last index of a character
description: Write a function `last_index(text, char)` that returns the position of the last occurrence of `char` in `text`, using `rfind()`.
hints: text.rfind(char) works like .find() but searches backward from the end, so it returns the position of the last match instead of the first.
Call .rfind() on text with char and return the result.
expected_behavior: Returns the index of the last occurrence of char.
explanation: The 'r' in rfind stands for 'reverse' - same lookup as find(), just anchored from the end of the string instead of the start.
